create_collater_audio: create a CollaterAudio instance with a custom batch_length for single audio batching
run_collater_audio_call: run the CollaterAudio collater on a batch of audio signals to get a tensor
create_collater_audio_pair: create a CollaterAudioPair instance with a custom batch_length for paired audio batching
run_collater_audio_pair_call: run the CollaterAudioPair collater on a batch of audio pairs to get input and output tensors
review_collater_random_segment: review the CollaterAudio _random_segment method that computes random start and end offsets for audio cutting
